scope: Production React and API handlers, exact isolated PostgreSQL migrations; synthetic Auth, REST/Storage transport and deterministic OCR provider

cognitiveLoad.decisions: Instrument choice, with PHQ-9 preselected; score and examination date are clinical values
Document action in the contextual menu; the source file is the required input
Scan action, one uncertain-answer correction in the tested source, final approval (2 choices for a fully legible source)
Scan action, accept the new hospitalization, retain the existing allergy, final approval; decisions scale only with relevant differences
Clinical registration status, with Already taking preselected; medication, dose and frequency are required values

counting: From the relevant tab already open. Action clicks count menu opening, action choice, native file-picker opening and Save/Approve; typing, field focus, native file selection and correction controls are separate. Decision counts include workflow selections and clinical approval judgments in the tested scenario, including preselected instrument/status choices; typing known clinical values is counted under fields. Source upload/review states stay within one dialog. Optional inspection of an original adds one download click; that verification action is recorded separately from the common entry-and-approval path.
limitations: Live OpenAI OCR was replaced by a deterministic provider response.
Supabase-owned Auth/REST/object byte transport was emulated in this local suite; exact application migrations, RPCs and RLS executed in isolated PGlite PostgreSQL.

Protected PDF originals use a compact download action. Browser download events and exact saved bytes were verified for documents, history and measurement originals; native PDF rendering is not used. The original PNG questionnaire rendered visibly.
No production database, real clinical data, external email or SMS was used.
finalRefinement: Desktop and mobile existing-patient workflow rerun after replacing unavailable native PDF previews with one protected download action, verifying saved bytes from generic documents, measurement originals and history review, and preserving adjacent image preview. The individual chart remains limited to 480px; concise results and manual-score actions and historical deep links remain verified.
